claims: Generation Z is the first generation to grow up with constant, high-speed digital connectivity.
As of 2026, Generation Z are between roughly 14 and 29 years old.
Generation Z are often called Zoomers.
McKinsey & Company notes that Generation Z consume social media to bond over shared passions and identities.
Generation Z is the most racially and ethnically diverse in U.S. history.
According to Wikipedia, Generation Z prioritize stability and financial security over pure passion.
As eMarketer says, Generation Z prioritize authenticity over polished branding.
EMarketer notes that Generation Z are quick to adapt to and use artificial intelligence and digital tools for daily tasks and shopping.
